APL 移动豁免耐伤
隐伏弃绝者
2 6" 2+ 11
守圣者：每个转折点限一次，当这名特工 2" 内且可
见的一名己方洁天使隐伏者特工在射击行动中被选
为有效目标或在近战行动中被选为近战目标时，您
可以使用本规则。若此，则这名特工成为这次近战
或射击行动的替代目标（即便通常情况它无法成为
此类目标）。若为近战行动，则将这名特工视为在
那次行动中处于近战特工的控制范围内。若为射击
行动，则这名特工只有在原本目标拥有掩护或遮挡
时拥有对应的掩护或遮挡。
若为射击行动，且对应的远程武器拥有“爆炸”
或“洪流”武器规则，则本规则没有效果。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
INSIDIANT ABJUROR
2 6" 2+ 11
Holy Defender: Once per turning point, when a friendly
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operative visible to and within 2"
of this operative is selected as the valid target of a Shoot action
or to fight against during the Fight action, you can use this rule.
If you do, this operative becomes the valid target or is fought
against (as appropriate) instead (even if it wouldn’t normally
be valid for this). If it’s the Fight action, treat this operative
as being within the fighting operative’s control range for the
duration of that action. If it’s the Shoot action, this operative is
only in cover or obscured if the original target was.
This rule has no effect if it’s the Shoot action and the ranged
weapon has the Blast or Torrent weapon rule.

Zealous Ultimatum: Once per battle STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Select one enemy operative within 8" of this operative and issue
an ultimatum to it. Your opponent must accept or decline that ultimatum (if it's a non-player operative, roll one D6: on a 4+, the
ultimatum is accepted, otherwise it’s declined).
If the ultimatum is accepted, whenever this operative is fighting against or retaliating against that enemy operative, add 1 to the
Atk stat of this operative's blessed broadsword. The first time this operative incapacitates that enemy operative while fighting or
retaliating during the battle, add 1 to the Atk stat of this operative’s blessed broadsword until the end of the battle. In either case, this
is to a maximum of 5.
If the ultimatum is declined, whenever that enemy operative is fighting against or retaliating against a friendly CELESTIAN
INSIDIANT operative, subtract 1 from the Atk stat of that enemy operative’s weapons.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
杀戮小队
原型：安全保护，搜索与摧毁
特工
↘ 1 名洁天使隐伏者长执特工，装备有以下一
种选项:
• 降罪者掷桩器；圣物爆矢手枪；虚无之槌
• 狱火手枪；虚无之槌
↘ 8 名洁天使隐伏者特工，从以下列表进行选
择:
• 弃绝者
• 肃戒者
• 焰灭者
• 揭谕者
• 圣殁者
• 司圣者
• 战士
除了焰灭者和战士特工以外，上述的每一名特工
只能被纳入您的杀戮小队一次。您的杀戮小队至
多可以纳入两名焰灭者特工。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANTS
KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPE: SECURITY, SEEK & DESTROY
OPERATIVES
↘ 1 CELESTIAN INSIDIANT SUPERIOR
operative with one of the following options:
• Relic condemnor stakethrower; relic bolt
pistol; null mace
• Inferno pistol; null mace
↘ 8 CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operatives selected
from the following list:
• ABJUROR
• CENSOR
• CREMATOR
• DENUNCIA
• MORTISANCTUS
• RELIQUARIUS
• WARRIOR
Other than CREMATOR and WARRIOR operatives,
your kill team can only include each operative on
this list once. Your kill team can only include up to
two CREMATOR operatives.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
阵营规则
殉道
作为武装修会万众瞩目的老兵，洁天使隐伏者
在猎巫中展现出了极端的偏执。而那些在任务
中阵亡的修女们会成为殉道者，其死亡只会让
幸存修女们的意志更为坚定。
每当处于圣勉状态的己方洁天使隐伏者特工残
废，在将其从杀戮区移除前，选择位于那名特
工 6" 内或对其可见的另一名己方洁天使隐伏者
特工。
随后，那名被选中的特工获得下表中的一个祷祝
（残废特工不能选择祷祝）：
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FACTION RULE
MARTYRDOM
Vaunted veterans of the Orders Militant, Celestian
Insidiants hunt witches with extreme prejudice. Those
struck down in the course of their duties become
martyrs, their deaths only serving to harden the resolve
of their surviving sisters.
Whenever an INSPIRING friendly CELESTIAN
INSIDIANT operative is incapacitated, before
it’s removed from the killzone, select one other
friendly CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operative that
operative is visible to or within 6" of.
Then, that selected operative gains one
BENEDICTION (incapacitated operatives cannot
be selected for a BENEDICTION).

数据卡上的武器获得“无
休”武器规则。
复兴那名特工恢复 D3+2 失去的
耐伤。
那名特工可以立即执行一次
疾步
无消耗的冲锋或冲刺行动
（若为前者，则它无法移动
超过 3"），但在结束移动时
必须距离那名残废圣勉特工
更近。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FACTION RULE
BENEDICTIONS
BENEDICTION EFFECT
Until the end of the battle,
add 1 to that operative’s
Ardour APL stat. You cannot select
this BENEDICTION for a
SUPERIOR operative.
Until the end of the battle,
weapons on that operative’s
Wrath
datacard have the Ceaseless
weapon rule.
That operative regains up to
Restoration
D3+2 lost wounds.
That operative can
immediately perform a
free Charge or Dash action
(for the former, it cannot
Exigence
move more than 3"), but
must end that move closer
to that incapacitated
INSPIRING operative.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
阵营规则
猎巫者的武备
洁天使隐伏者携带了各种神秘的武器，护甲
以及装备免遭巫术之害，阻止猎物施展恶毒
之力。
灵能远程武器无法对己方洁天使隐伏者特工造
成伤害。在灵能行动的效果中，己方洁天使隐伏
者特工无法被选择，并且不会被视为处于这些
行动需要的范围内。每当一名特工位于一名己方
洁天使隐伏者特工 3" 内时：
• 那名特工无法执行灵能行动或使用灵能额外
规则。
• 那名特工无法使用灵能远程武器。
• 灵能近战武器失去武器规则并且伤害属性不能
高于 3/4。
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FACTION RULE
WEAPONS OF THE WITCH HUNTERS
Celestian Insidiants bear all manner of esoteric
weapons, armour and equipment intended to shield
them from sorcery and impede the ability of their quarry
to channel malefic power.
PSYCHIC ranged weapons cannot inflict damage
on friendly CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operatives.
For the effects of PSYCHIC actions, friendly
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operatives cannot be
selected and are never treated as being within
those actions’ required distances. Whenever an
operative is within 3" of a friendly CELESTIAN
INSIDIANT operative:
• That operative cannot perform PSYCHIC
actions or use PSYCHIC additional rules.
• That operative cannot use PSYCHIC
ranged weapons.
• PSYCHIC melee weapons have no weapon rules
and cannot have Dmg stats higher than 3/4.
RULE CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
本小队中一些武器拥有如下所示的反灵能者武器
规则。
*反灵能者：每当这个武器作用于一名拥有灵能
者关键词的特工时，它便获得“致命 5+”武器
规则。
cards.text_en:
Some weapons in this team’s rules have the
Anti-PSYKER weapon rule below.
*Anti-PSYKER: Whenever this weapon is being
used against an operative that has the PSYKER
keyword, it has the Lethal 5+ weapon rule.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
阵营规则
圣勉
武装修会的洁天使精英们身先士卒，激励着其
他修女投身于与致命敌人的殊死战斗。
当一名己方洁天使隐伏者特工：
• 使耐伤属性为 6 点或更多的敌方特工残废时，
那名己方特工便处于圣勉状态。
• 执行冲锋行动，在移动前，它便处于圣勉状
态。
每当一名己方洁天使隐伏者特工处于圣勉状
态，则它数据卡上的武器获得“严重”武器规
则。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FACTION RULE
INSPIRATION
Veteran Celestians of the Orders Militant lead by
example, inspiring their sisters by throwing themselves
into the heaviest fighting against the deadliest
of enemies.
Whenever a friendly CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
operative:
• Incapacitates an enemy operative that has
a Wounds stat of 6 or more, that friendly
operative becomes INSPIRING.
• Performs the Charge action, before it moves, it
becomes INSPIRING.
Whenever a friendly CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
operative is INSPIRING, weapons on its datacard
have the Severe weapon rule.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
战略计谋
猜疑并歼灭
在追捕巫师时，洁天使隐伏者会迅速且无情地
定罪他们怀疑为异端的人。任何无辜的辩解和
抗议都将被冷酷无情地忽视。
选择一名敌方特工或标识。若您选择了一名敌
方特工，则直至这个转折点结束前，那名特工
和每一名位于其 2" 内且可见的每一名其他敌方
特工获得一枚己方猜疑指示物。若您选择了一
枚标识，则直至这个转折点结束前，每一个争
夺那枚标识的敌方特工获得一枚己方猜疑指示
物。
每当一名己方洁天使隐伏者特工对拥有一枚己
方猜疑指示物的特工进行射击或执行近战时，
那名己方特工的武器获得“重击”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
STRATEGY PLOY
SUSPECT & ELIMINATE
Ruthless in their pursuit of the witch, Celestian
Insidiants are swift to condemn those they suspect of
heresy. Protestations of innocence are treated with the
callous disregard they deserve.
Select one enemy operative or marker. If you
select an enemy operative, that operative and
each other enemy operative visible to and within
2" of it gains one of your Suspicion tokens until
the end of the turning point. If you selected a
marker, each enemy operative contesting that
marker gains one of your Suspicion tokens until
the end of the turning point.
Whenever a friendly CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
operative is shooting against or fighting against
an operative that has one of your Suspicion
tokens, that friendly operative's weapons have
the Punishing weapon rule.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
战略计谋
毅然怒火
一旦洁天使隐伏者察觉到巫术的踪影，便会不
顾刀山火海紧追不舍。
每当一名特工射击一名拥有交战命令的己方洁
天使隐伏者特工，您便可以重掷一枚己方防御
骰子。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
STRATEGY PLOY
WRATHFUL DETERMINATION
Once the Celestian Insidiants have detected the spoor
of sorcery, they will pursue their targets through hails
of fire.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operative that has
an Engage order, you can re-roll one of your
defence dice.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
战略计谋
神圣强韧
在洁天使隐伏者的众多武器中，信仰是最强大
的那个。只要它依然坚挺，便能够摆脱那些最
为严重的伤损，继续战斗。
每当一名己方处于圣勉状态的洁天使隐伏者
特工执行近战或反击时，普通或暴击伤害为 4
点或更多的伤害对那个特工造成的伤害减去 1
点。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
STRATEGY PLOY
SUFFERING & SACRIFICE
Battlefield veterans all, Celestian Insidiants are inured
to pain. Injuries serve only to focus their martial prowess
and stoke their zealous rage.
Whenever a wounded friendly CELESTIAN
INSIDIANT operative is shooting against, fighting
against or retaliating against an enemy operative,
its weapons have the Balanced weapon rule.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
战略计谋
苦难与牺牲
作为战场老兵，洁天使隐伏者早已习惯了伤
损。承受伤痛对她们而言仅仅意味着应当专注
于自己的武艺，释放自己的狂热怒火。
每当一名受伤己方洁天使隐伏者特工对一名
敌方特工执行射击，近战或反击时，其武器获
得“平衡”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
STRATEGY PLOY
HOLY RESILIENCE
Faith is the greatest of the Celestian Insidiants’ many
weapons. So long as it remains unbroken, they may
shrug off even the most crippling of injuries and remain
in the fight.
Whenever an INSPIRING friendly CELESTIAN
INSIDIANT operative is fighting or retaliating,
Normal and Critical Dmg of 4 or more inflicts 1
less damage on that friendly operative.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
交战计谋
殉道荣光
没什么能比殉道者光荣战死带来更多圣勉的
了。
当一名己方洁天使隐伏者特工在近战或反击中
残废时使用此交战计谋。在将其从杀戮区移除
前，您可以在那次流程中使用一枚己方未经结算
的成功进行出击。若那名敌方特工因此残废，则
那名己方特工在其移出杀戮区前处于圣勉状态，
并且您可以由此结算殉道阵营规则。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
GLORY TO THE MARTYRS
There is no greater inspiration than the glorious death
of a martyr.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly CELESTIAN
INSIDIANT operative is incapacitated while
fighting or retaliating. You can strike the enemy
operative in that sequence with one of your
unresolved successes before it’s removed
from the killzone. If that enemy operative is
incapacitated as a result, that friendly operative
becomes INSPIRING before it’s removed from
the killzone and you can resolve the Martyrdom
faction rule.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
交战计谋
信念与怒火
神圣的怒火赋予这些战士横扫群敌的力量。
在一名己方洁天使隐伏者特工在近战流程中使
用关键成功进行出击时使用此交战计谋。那次
出击结算后，每一名位于那名己方特工 2" 内且
可见的其他敌方特工将按您希望的顺序各自受
到 D3 点伤害（为每一名特工分别掷骰）。请注
意，若任何耐伤属性为 6 点或更多的敌方特工
因为这个伤害而残废，则这名己方特工便处于圣
勉状态。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
FAITH & FURY
Divine rage empowers these warriors to cleave through
multiple foes.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly CELESTIAN
INSIDIANT operative is fighting and you strike
the enemy operative in that sequence with a
critical success. After resolving that strike, also
inflict D3 damage on each other enemy operative
visible to and within 2" of that friendly operative
in an order of your choice (roll separately for
each). Note that the friendly operative would
become INSPIRING if any enemy operatives with
a Wounds stat of 6 or more are incapacitated as a
result of this damage.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
交战计谋
穷追不舍
无论是身心受挫还是地形阻碍，洁天使隐伏者
都不会让猎物逃脱。
在一名己方洁天使隐伏者特工激活中执行行动
的之前或之后使用此交战计谋。直到那名特工激
活结束前，您可以忽视任何对其移动属性的修
正。若那名特工处于圣勉状态，则在那次激活结
束前为其移动属性增加 1"。若那名特工通过执行
冲锋行动处于圣勉状态，则您可以在其移动前使
用本计谋以获得额外的移动数值（这优先于行动
过程中数值不变的规则）。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
UNSHAKEABLE PURSUIT
Neither fatigue nor terrain can keep a Celestian Insidiant
from their quarry.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operative’s activation,
before or after it performs an action. Until the
end of that operative’s activation, you can ignore
any changes to its Move stat. If that operative
is INSPIRING, add 1" to its Move stat until the
end of that activation. If that operative becomes
INSPIRING by performing the Charge action,
you can use this ploy before it moves to gain the
additional movement (this takes precedence over
stats not changing during an action).

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
交战计谋
炽热憎恨
洁天使隐伏者将她们的信仰化作偏执的仇恨。
在为一名己方洁天使隐伏者特工进行攻击掷骰
后，若其执行射击，近战或反击的敌方特工没有
帝国关键词，使用此交战计谋。那名己方特工的
武器在那个流程结束前获得“无休”武器规则；
若那名敌方特工还拥有混沌和/或灵能者关键词，
则那名己方特工的武器在那个流程中拥有“毫不
留情”武器规则作为替代。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
FERVENT HATE
The Celestian Insidiants embody the hatred and
paranoia of their creed.
Use this firefight ploy after rolling your attack dice
for a friendly CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operative, if
it’s shooting against, fighting against or retaliating
against an enemy operative that doesn’t have
the IMPERIUM keyword. That friendly operative’s
weapons have the Ceaseless weapon rule
until the end of that sequence; if that enemy
operative also has the CHAOS and/or PSYKER
keyword, that friendly operative’s weapons have
the Relentless weapon rule until the end of that
sequence instead.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
阵营装备
灭灵手雷
强大的灭灵手雷能对灵能者造成尤为巨大的
伤害。
这个装备可以允许您选择两枚功能型手雷（见
通用装备），并且必须选择两枚震荡手雷，若您
还正常选择了这一装备，则您无法再选择任意数
量震荡手雷（即：您不能由此获得超过两枚此手
雷）。每当一名特工由于一名己方洁天使隐伏者
特工执行震荡手雷行动而进行震荡测试时，若
结果为 3+，则那个首名特工同时受到等同于掷
骰结果半数（向上取整）的伤害。若那个首名特
工拥有灵能者关键词，则受到等同于掷骰结果数
值的伤害。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
PSYK-OUT GRENADES
Powerful psyk-out grenades are particularly potent
against psykers.
This equipment allows you to select two utility
grenades from the utility grenades equipment
(see universal equipment) and they must all be
stun grenades. If you also select that equipment
as normal, you cannot select any stun grenades
(i.e. to give you more than two). Whenever an
operative takes a stun test as a result of a friendly
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operative performing
the Stun Grenade action, if the result is a 3+,
also inflict damage on it equal to the dice result
halved (rounding up). If that first operative has
the PSYKER keyword, inflict damage on it equal
to the dice result instead.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
阵营装备
殉道悼歌
随着佩戴者的死亡，这个装置便会在小队的通
讯频道中发送一首肃穆的安魂曲，宣告这位修
女的殉道。
每场战斗限一次，当一名处于圣勉状态的己方
洁天使隐伏者特工残废时，您可以使用这个规
则。若此，使用殉道阵营规则时，可以选择对
那名残废特工不可见或不位于其 6" 内的另一名
己方特工。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
VOCIFERA MORTIS
Upon the death of its bearer, this device transmits
a sombre requiem across the squad’s vox-channel,
broadcasting the sister’s martyrdom.
Once per battle, when an INSPIRING
friendly CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operative is
incapacitated, you can use this rule. If you do,
for the Martyrdom faction rule, the other friendly
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operative you select
can be one that isn’t visible to or within 6" of
that operative.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
阵营装备
遗珍圣物
猎巫者们携带着各种虔诚的神秘物品，坚信
这能让自己免遭伤害，让自己继续践行神圣
使命。
当一枚攻击骰子将要对一名己方洁天使隐伏者
特工造成伤害时，您可以使用这个规则。若此，
掷一枚 D6，若那名特工处于圣勉状态，则掷两
枚 D6 作为替代：若有任意结果为 6，则无视那
枚攻击骰子造成的伤害。您在每次行动中以此方
式无视的攻击骰子不能超过一枚，并且在每场战
斗中以此方式无视的攻击骰子不能超过两枚。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
SAINTLY RELICS
The witch hunters carry a variety of devotional esoterica
believed to shield them from harm, enabling them to
continue their holy duties.
Whenever an attack dice would inflict damage on
a friendly CELESTIAN INSIDIANT operative, you
can use this rule. If you do, roll one D6, or two D6
if that operative is INSPIRING: if any result is a 6,
ignore the damage inflicted from that attack dice.
You cannot ignore more than one attack dice per
action and two attack dice per battle this way.

cards.text:
洁天使隐伏者
阵营装备
自动鞭策装置
那些最为虔诚的洁天使隐伏者可能会在动力装
甲内携带用于自我鞭挞的装置。在那些关键时
刻，这种装置便会给身体带去苦痛，迫使心神
专注，让使用者做出狂热的行为。
每当一名己方洁天使隐伏者特工激活时，您便
可以使用这个规则。若此，掷一枚 D6 并对那名
特工造成等同于掷骰结果半数（向上取整）的伤
害；若掷骰结果为 4+，那名特工也处于圣勉状
态。您在每个转折点中不能通过这个规则使一名
以上的己方特工处于圣勉状态。
cards.text_en:
CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
AUTO-FLAGELLATOR
The most devout of Celestian Insidiants may bear
beneath their power armour instruments of self-
flagellation. At times of great import, these devices
inflict agonising pain upon the body, focusing the mind
and spirit and driving the recipient to inspirational acts
of zealotry.
Whenever a friendly CELESTIAN INSIDIANT
operative is activated, you can use this rule. If
you do, roll one D6 and inflict damage on that
operative equal to half the result (rounding
up); on a 4+, that operative also becomes
INSPIRING. You cannot make more than one
friendly operative INSPIRING using this rule per
turning point.
